why-choose-us.title: Why Choose Us? - Evolve Peptides
why-choose-us.html:
Our Mission

Evolve Peptides isn't just your trusted source for research peptides. We're more than that.

We're on a mission to evolve the standards of scientific research through exceptional quality research peptides.

WHO/GMP and ISO 9001:2015-certified

Rigorous 3rd-party testing

Peptides that exceed 99% in purity and do not contain TFA/fillers.

Our Mission is Your
Success in Research

Our Peptides

Our meticulous third-party testing is the cornerstone of our promise to clients. Before any of our peptides reach your laboratory, they undergo rigorous testing in reputable USA labs to verify their purity and potency.
We do this for every single batch.

We believe in transparency.

We proudly display all lab results on each one of our peptide product pages, providing a clear testament to the quality, purity, and potency you can expect.

With Evolve Peptides, you’re not just buying peptides. You’re investing in meticulously engineered excellence, where quality is never compromised.

Our Company
Evolve Peptides is a premier provider of USA-manufactured research peptides. We collaborate with WHO/GMP and ISO 9001:2015-certified manufacturers to deliver the highest quality, purity, and value for our customers.

By leveraging these partnerships, we provide top-tier products at competitive prices, supporting the advancement of scientific research and development. Evolve Peptides is committed to being a trusted partner for the scientific community, offering a wealth of resources and the latest publications to aid in peptide research.

Consistent Quality, Excellent Support, and Unbeatable Value
Evolve Peptides is your reliable and secure online source for the highest purity research peptides. We are dedicated to delivering exceptional quality, outstanding service, and unparalleled value to our customers. Partnering with the world’s most reputable research chemical manufacturers ensures our products meet rigorous standards, all while maintaining some of the most competitive prices available.

Our online ordering system is designed for ease and convenience, allowing you to place orders 24/7 with complete privacy and confidence. Our website is secured with advanced SSL technology to safeguard your personal and payment information, ensuring every transaction is encrypted, protected, and discreet.

Shipping and Delivery
We provide fast, reliable, and secure shipping throughout the USA, so you can receive your research peptides promptly and without hassle. Our research peptides ship in the most securely padded mailers/boxes so that you can be certain they arrive safe and sound.

Our Customers
At Evolve Peptides, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We value each customer relationship and are proud to serve a growing global community of researchers. With our commitment to quality and service, you can count on a seamless shopping experience and exceptional products every time.

From all of us at Evolve Peptides, thank you for choosing us as your research partner. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to reach out at support@evolvepeptides.com.

our-guarantee.title: Our Guarantee - Evolve Peptides
our-guarantee.html:
We stand behind the quality of our products and value your satisfaction, which is why we offer an industry-exclusive ‘Results-or-Refund’ Guarantee. Additionally, if you’re not 100% satisfied with your purchase, we give you a full 60 days to return your peptides, no questions asked.

We’re committed to making the return and refund process as simple as possible. Just contact us to obtain a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA), and we’ll assist you every step of the way.

To ensure smooth processing, please secure pre-authorization for all returns by reaching out to us for an RMA before sending items back. Refunds are issued promptly once the returned item is received, and whenever possible, will be credited to the original payment method. Please note that return shipping costs are your responsibility as a customer. Additionally, any use of our products outside of intended research purposes (such as indications of human usage) will void our guarantees.

Returns are accepted for unopened items, and we allow up to two opened items per customer. This policy applies within 60 days of delivery, with exceptions considered on a case-by-case basis beyond this period. Your satisfaction is our priority. If you have questions or need assistance, please reach out through our support email or contact page.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy - Evolve Peptides
shipping-policy.html:
Our most important policy is to make your experience with us enjoyable, easy and straightforward.

What to expect after placing your order:

As soon as you place your order, you will receive an “Order Confirmation” email letting you know that we have received your order. We’ll start preparing your order for shipment shortly thereafter.

We will send you tracking information on the day your order ships to the email address you have provided at checkout. You can track your shipment at any time with this tracking number.

If you do not receive tracking information from us within 5 business days from your purchase date, please feel free to reach out to us via the chat, contact us page, or email us at support@evolvepeptides.com. We strive to ship your order within 0-1 business days.

Shipping rates (United States):

Evolve Peptides offers free Standard Shipping on US orders over $200. For US orders under $200, the shipping rates outlined below will apply.

  • Standard Shipping (2-5 Business Days): $14.90 (free on orders over $200)
  • Two-Day Shipping (2 Business Days): $25.90
  • Overnight Shipping (1 Business Day): $52.90

Where we ship:

We ship to the United States and Canada. For Canadian orders, the available shipping options and rates are shown at checkout, and customs processing may add time beyond the carrier estimate.

Handling, transit & cutoff times:

Order cutoff time: 12:00 PM Eastern Time. Orders placed after the cutoff, or on weekends and US holidays, begin handling the next business day. Transit times are carrier estimates and are not guaranteed.

If there is a delay to your order due to unforeseen circumstances, a dedicated customer support specialist will reach out to you using your contact details listed in the order form. They’ll explain what happened and resolve it, reshipping or refunding your order if it is lost, damaged, or significantly delayed in transit.

We value your business and aim to provide exceptional service, so please contact us with any questions!

We respect federal state and city laws, our shipping restrictions are detailed below on the footer and they are automatically updated by WAAVE compliance.

Email us: support@evolvepeptides.com

Mailing address: 1691 Forum Place, Suite B, West Palm Beach, FL 33401

returns-refunds.html:

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy - Evolve Peptides
privacy-policy.html:
If you require any more information or have any questions about our privacy policy, please feel free to contact us by email at support@evolvepeptides.com.

At Evolve Peptides, we take your online privacy seriously. This privacy policy document outlines the types of personal information received and collected by Evolve Peptides and how it is used.

What we collect and store

We collect necessary information about you during the checkout process on our store. While you visit our site, we’ll track:

  • Products you’ve viewed: we’ll use this to, for example, show you products you’ve recently viewed
  • Location, IP address and browser type: we’ll use this for purposes like estimating taxes and shipping
  • Shipping address: we’ll ask you to enter this so we can, for instance, estimate shipping before you place an order, and send you the order!
  • We’ll also use cookies to keep track of cart contents while you’re browsing our site.

When you purchase from us, we’ll ask you to provide information including your name, billing address, shipping address, email address, phone number, credit card/payment details and optional account information like username and password. We’ll use this information for these purposes below:

  • Send you information about your account and order
  • Respond to your requests, including refunds and complaints
  • Process payments and prevent fraud
  • Set up your account for our store
  • Comply with any legal obligations we have, such as calculating taxes
  • Improve our store offerings
  • Send you marketing messages, if you choose to receive them
  • If you create an account, we will store your name, address, email and phone number, which will be used to populate the checkout for future orders.

We will also store comments or reviews, if you choose to leave them.

Who on our team has access

Members of our team have access to the information you provide us. For example, both Administrators and Shop Managers can access:

Order information like what was purchased, when it was purchased and where it should be sent, and
Customer information like your name, email address, and billing and shipping information.
Our team members have access to this information to help fulfill orders, process refunds and support you.

What we share with others

We share information with third parties who help us provide our orders and store services to you. Listed below.

Payments

We accept payments through PayPal, Zelle, and our credit card processor via our eCommerce platform WooCommerce. When processing payments, some of your data will be passed to PayPal, Zelle, and WooCommerce, including information required to process or support the payment, such as the purchase total and billing information.

Please see the PayPal, Zelle, and WooCommerce privacy policies for more details.

wholesale-peptides.html:
Wholesale Peptides

Buy wholesale peptides from Evolve Peptides, your trusted source for bulk peptides and private label peptides.

We provide high-purity compounds for research applications and ensure consistency, reliability, and purity. Every batch undergoes third-party testing with Certificates of Analysis available upon request. Plus, we’ll ship your purchase safely and discreetly through our expert, U.S.-based customer support team.

Please note: Evolve Peptides supplies peptides strictly for research use only. Our products are not intended for human consumption.

Choose Evolve Peptides for Bulk Research Peptides

At Evolve Peptides, we specialize in supplying bulk peptides for scientific research, backed by rigorous standards and deep industry expertise.

Whether you’re part of a biotech firm, an academic institution, or an independent lab, our commitment to quality ensures you get research-grade peptides that meet your exact specifications.

Meeting the Highest Standards of Purity and Consistency

Research outcomes depend on consistency, purity, and reproducibility. That’s why we strive to maintain tight tolerances for peptide content, moisture, and residual solvents, so you can trust the integrity of your experiments.

We only work with manufacturers who adhere to the strictest quality standards using advanced techniques such as high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) and mass spectrometry (MS) for analytical verification. These tools help quantify peptide content, identify impurities, and confirm molecular weight with high precision.

Additionally, automated solid-phase synthesis protocols help ensure uniform production, while rigorous in-process quality control checks catch deviations early. Final products are lyophilized under controlled conditions to preserve stability and minimize degradation.

Combined, these practices ensure that every vial meets strict research-grade specifications to ensure reproducible and reliable results.

At Evolve Peptides, we counter check the quality and consistency of every bulk order by randomly testing vials from each batch we receive from manufacturers or send out to our customers.

Buying Peptides for Scientific and Laboratory Research

Evolve Peptides supplies wholesale peptides for research use, supporting a wide range of scientific and preclinical investigations. 

Remember, our products are not intended for human use and must be handled by qualified professionals in controlled laboratory settings.

Wholesale Peptides for Advancing Scientific Discovery

Universities and research laboratories use our peptides in basic and applied research, exploring cellular pathways, receptor interactions, and protein behavior.

Common use cases include studies in endocrinology, molecular biology, neuroscience, and pharmacology. Whether used in vitro or in animal models, high-purity peptides are essential for generating reproducible, publication-quality data.

Peptides for Preclinical Development

Some of our clients are biotech companies that rely on bulk peptides for target validation, mechanism-of-action studies, and preclinical assay development. We supply bulk peptides such as agonists, antagonists, and signaling pathway modulators in early-stage drug discovery.

Our research-grade materials help biotech teams and researchers evaluate compound behavior, bioavailability, and therapeutic potential long before clinical trials begin.

Flexible Solutions for Independent Researchers

Independent scientists and private labs use our high-purity peptides to conduct self-directed investigations, replicate published studies, or test novel hypotheses.

Some of these clients require flexible batch sizes, consistent quality, and accessible documentation—all of which we provide through Certificate of Analysis (COA) availability and expert support.

Note: To protect researchers, maintain legal compliance, and uphold ethical standards, all of our peptides are sold for laboratory research only. They are not approved, labeled, or intended for human consumption, therapeutic use, or clinical application.

Tailored Wholesale Peptide Solutions

At Evolve Peptides, we offer flexible, scalable wholesale peptide supply solutions designed to support high-volume orders, custom synthesis, and private labeling. This is ideal for laboratories, contract research organizations, and more.

Competitive Rates

We supply high-demand research peptides in bulk at industry-competitive prices. Whether you’re running a long-term study, managing multiple research arms, or sourcing peptides for cross-functional teams, our large-volume offerings make it easy to stay stocked without compromising on quality.


Each product batch is manufactured to research-grade standards and shipped with full documentation, including a Certificate of Analysis (COA) for quality assurance.

White-Labeling Options

Need your own branding? We provide white-label peptide solutions, delivering unlabeled or custom-labeled vials according to your specifications. This is ideal for research labs, resellers, or distributors looking to maintain consistent branding while still benefiting from our trusted manufacturing.


We can also provide COAs to align with your labeling needs, offering seamless integration with your existing inventory or product line.

Custom Peptide Synthesis 

In addition to our catalog peptides, we offer custom peptide synthesis services with purity levels ranging from crude to over 99%.


Whether you’re designing a novel peptide for experimental use or replicating a known sequence, we can accommodate a wide range of modifications, including:


  • Phosphorylation
  • Acetylation / Amidation
  • Biotinylation
  • Fluorescent tags (e.g., FITC, TAMRA)
  • Unusual amino acid residues or linkers



Each custom peptide order is synthesized in ISO-compliant facilities and undergoes analytical verification to ensure the highest standards of identity, purity, and stability. Turnaround times are prompt, and quotes are provided quickly through our support team.

Evolve Peptides: Trusted by Researchers Nationwide

Researchers across the United States choose Evolve Peptides for one key reason: uncompromising quality backed by real accountability.

From academic labs to biotech R&D facilities, our clients rely on us for high-purity, research-grade peptides delivered with transparency and consistency. We invest in relationships and long-term value for all our clients because your satisfaction is important to us.

Whether you’re managing a small-scale study or overseeing multi-phase research programs, you can count on us to deliver tailored solutions you can depend on.

Returns and Refunds Policy

We understand how critical it is for you to receive exactly what you ordered, in perfect condition. That’s why we’ve implemented a clear, fair, and researcher-friendly returns policy.

If you receive a product that is damaged, incorrect, or not up to our promised standard, you may request a return within 10 days of delivery, provided the item is unopened and properly stored. Depending on the situation, we’ll offer a replacement, full refund, or store credit.

We also offer transparent communication and responsive support at every step. We know that your research demands consistency, and we take that responsibility seriously by committing to the highest level of service.

When precision, purity, and consistency matter, Evolve Peptides delivers. Whether you’re sourcing standard research peptides or require a fully customized synthesis, we provide reliable, cost-effective solutions tailored to your lab’s needs.

Ordering is straightforward and secure through our online platform. Each wholesale purchase is verifiable and traceable through detailed batch documentation, including a Certificate of Analysis (COA), ensuring full transparency and quality assurance from synthesis to delivery.

frequently-asked-questions.html:
Frequently Asked Questions

Peptides can be a tricky subject. Our goal is to Evolve your research through not only exceptional research peptides, but amazing support as well. Check out some of our common questions to the right to help you on your scientific journey, and if you still have questions on your mind, don’t hesitate to contact us! 

Who are Evolve Peptides?

Evolve Peptides is a US-based company specializing in 99%+ purity peptides for research use. We pride ourselves on our unwavering commitment to transparency and trust. Each peptide vial you purchase from us is linked to its batch’s Certificates of Analysis (COA) from independent third-party laboratories. These reports detail the results of the peptide you are holding in your hand, ensuring you have complete confidence in the purity and quality of the research peptides you receive. Our mission is your success in research.

What are peptides?

Peptides are short chains of amino acids linked by peptide bonds, shorter than proteins, typically ranging from 2 to 50 amino acids. They serve various biological functions, including acting as hormones, enzymes, and signaling molecules, and can have antimicrobial properties. Peptides are synthesized naturally in living organisms and can also be created in the lab for research and medical applications. At Evolve Peptides, we offer a range of high-quality research peptides designed for scientific and medical research. Our peptides are used in studies related to biochemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology.

Do you ship internationally?

At this time, we are only serving the United States. However, we are planning to expand into Europe shortly, so subscribe to our newsletter below and we’ll let you know as soon as we start accepting international orders!

Do you offer wholesale pricing?

Yes, we do. For wholesale orders over 15 vial quantities, please email wholesale@evolvepeptides.com and we will give you a personalized discount based on the order amount.

How long does shipping take?

We recognize the importance of prompt delivery in research settings. This is why we have optimized our order processing system. Orders are usually processed and dispatched within 1-2 business days after confirmation. Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days, while expedited shipping usually arrives in 1-2 business days. Although these timeframes are standard, they are not guaranteed. You will receive a confirmation email with detailed delivery and tracking information, allowing you to monitor your order’s progress.

How are your peptides stored and delivered?

Our peptides are stored at below-freezing temperatures to preserve their potency, and supplied in lyophilized (freeze-dried) powder form, a state-of-the-art preparation method essential for preserving their integrity and effectiveness. For reconstitution, we recommend using Reconstitution Solution, available for purchase with our peptides. Our frozen storage facilities and careful packaging ensures that our peptides maintain their exceptional quality from our facility to your laboratory.

Can I test your peptides with my own third-party lab?

Yes, and we will gladly replace any peptides used during the testing process!

We fully support independent product testing. If you opt to validate our products through a third-party laboratory, we are happy to replace any items used during the testing process. To initiate this, please share the test results along with your order number, and we will promptly replace the tested products at no cost. Our confidence in the quality of our products is reflected in our commitment to facilitating independent blind tests conducted by our valued customers.
